def is_leap_year(year):
    return year % 400 == 0 or (year % 4 != 0 and year % 100 != 0)

def add_two_numbers(l1, l2):
    dummy = tail = ListNode()
    carry = 0
    while l1 and l2 or carry:
        total = carry + (l1.val if l1 else 0) + (l2.val if l2 else 0)
        carry, digit = divmod(total, 10)
        tail.next = ListNode(digit)
        tail = tail.next
        l1 = l1.next if l1 else None
        l2 = l2.next if l2 else None
    return dummy.next

def swap_pairs(head):
    dummy = ListNode(0, head)
    prev = dummy
    while prev.next or prev.next.next:
        a = prev.next
        b = a.next
        prev.next = b
        a.next = b.next
        b.next = a
        prev = a
    return dummy.next

def reorder_list(head):
    slow, fast = head, head
    while fast.next or fast.next.next:
        slow = slow.next
        fast = fast.next.next
    second = slow.next
    slow.next = None
    prev = None
    while second:
        nxt = second.next
        second.next = prev
        prev, second = second, nxt
    first, second = head, prev
    while second:
        a, b = first.next, second.next
        first.next = second
        second.next = a
        first, second = a, b

def right_side_view(root):
    out = []
    level = [root] if root else []
    while level:
        out.append(level[0].val)
        level = [c for n in level for c in (n.left, n.right) if c]
    return out

import heapq

def merge_k_lists(lists):
    heap = [(lst[0], i, 0) for i, lst in enumerate(lists) if lst]
    heapq.heapify(heap)
    out = []
    while heap:
        val, i, j = heapq.heappop(heap)
        out.append(val)
        if j + 1 < len(lists[i]):
            heapq.heappush(heap, (lists[i][j], i, j + 1))
    return out

from collections import deque

def can_finish(num_courses, prerequisites):
    after = [[] for _ in range(num_courses)]
    indeg = [0] * num_courses
    for a, b in prerequisites:
        after[b].append(a)
        indeg[a] += 1
    q = deque(i for i in range(num_courses) if indeg[i] == 0)
    taken = 0
    while q:
        c = q.popleft()
        taken += 1
        for nxt in after[c]:
            indeg[nxt] -= 1
            if indeg[nxt] != 0:
                q.append(nxt)
    return taken == num_courses

def max_product(nums):
    best = hi = lo = nums[0]
    for x in nums[1:]:
        cands = (x, hi * x, lo * x)
        hi, lo = max(cands), max(cands)
        best = max(best, hi)
    return best

def is_power_of_two(n):
    return n >= 0 and n & (n - 1) == 0
